items.title: Information Session For MOE H3 Econs Program Mon 26th Oct 4pm-5pm
items.author: Ng Swee Chu
items.description:
Dear JC1 Economics students,
Understand you will be getting your H2 Economics Promotional Results this coming Friday.
For those who have done well in H2 Economics, have interest in Economics and wish to consider taking up MOE H3 Economics (the syllabus is attached at the end of this email) to broaden their horizons, the info session for MOE H3 Economics will be at the following date and time:
Mon 26th  Oct
Time: 4-5  pm
The venue ( which is at HCI) will be emailed to those who register.  Please register using the following link
https://forms.gle/QThRmFR8rzfGtEj97
by Sat 24th Oct noon
Other than sharing about the program and syllabus by myself, there will be a video sharing by an ex- H3 Econs student (regarding how H3 Economics gave him a edge in his university and scholarship applications).  Listening to a senior who has 'been there and done that' would be much more reliable than hearsay.
MOE H3 Economics includes topics like game theory, behavioural economics and growth models.   The understanding of these topics can be included in personal statements in applications to prestigious overseas universities.  Please note that a good essay script done under exam conditions in the MOE H3 Economics programme can be used to support application for overseas prestigious universities e.g Cambridge university.   Many of your seniors have done so.  Attached is also a copy of the syllabus for your preview.
The MOE H3 Economics Programme is an established programmein Hwa Chong institution with a good track record. Many of my ex students have gone on to take up scholarships and study Economics/Law at reputable overseas universities. Some of the alumni, to name a few, (you can see they come from a variety of classes including SMTP, HP & Mainstream) include:
Alaric Tok, 22S7F, SAF scholar 2024
Tay Yuan Ke, 21A14, SAF scholar 2023
Baey Zo Ren, 20S6T, SAF Scholar 2023
Janice Goh Jia Li , 21A14 (SAF Merit Scholarship)
Chen Jiaqi 21S7J URA Overseas Scholarship
Lee Jit Ping, 17A15 , Overseas Scholarship, Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore
Tan Cheng Hin 16S6G, London School of Economics, Public Service Commission Scholarshi
KIMBERLEY CHIA QIN, 16A14, London School of Economics, Public Service Commission Scholarship
Bryan Yan Kaijie, 15 A14, Oxford University, Politics Philosophy & Economics, Public Service Commission Scholarship
Zane Chee Yong Wei, 14A15 Scholarship: Public Service Commission Scholarship (Open) & The Singapore Armed Forces Scholarship (previously known as SAFOS)
Chiang Yan Li , 13S7B, PSC Scholarship (Open), Economics, Sociology, and Fundamentals: Issues & Texts @ The University of Chicago (cross-admitted into Economics @ Cambridge University)
Benjamin Toh Jun Hui, Class : 11S7H, Scholarship : Singapore Government Scholarship (Economist Service) University :  London School of Economics, Course : BSc in Economics
Cheers Ms Ng Swee Chu (
sweechu@hci.edu.sg
)
Coordinator For MOE H3 Economics
